**3h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/3d5ba1dc47d5a4985aae9af70a6efb72e86c61f3082011a2bd6212ec140d47a7.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/dc18f2853416022304a95f45b280640daa07c48c084e0fcc709c99e5248ac7a3.png)
So I once again forgot that there was a starting reel, and worked on this yesterday, so once again written a day in advance. I completed the first version of the rear wheel that night, and only suffered a little to get tolerances right (I think I did 3 separate 3d to try to work that stuff out, and I didn't include the time that those were printing in this time as I wasn't sure if that counted. I am including measuring and testing in this time however, and I really need an assembly guide because the amount of time I spent staring at the OnShape document trying to decern what goes where can not be healthy.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/8b181615a6d9f31a99b6bae3be48b2649b7f220e222b4a9a7ea6b51b30d4cd74.png)
Anyways, finished product rear wheel assembly here, I did make the decision to include bearing in the design because I thought they looked cool.

### 2026-10-14 – Front and middle sections "complete"

**3h**

Front and middle sections "complete"
Today I worked on the front and middle sections of the long distance car, and have got them to a state where I can 3D print them to test tolerances. I think they look pretty good, although I am going to check the size of the A1 mini to make sure it will fit on that build plate. (I want this model to be accessible to people who don't have massive printers).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/7dbba20ae0dbb7b7449e561d96c801b66fb5b1f88a422de9ba2b6f0e7b79c3ea.png)

Dimensions wise, the rear wheel is 150mm in diameter, and the front wheels are 75mm. It is about 400mm long, and I may need to widen the wheelbase which is 60mm.

In all, there are 3 main sections...
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/04b7d2a8795166307295f445f5273ab377569c57627d4a8fc05cd57e03b0fc1a.png)

and 23 parts..
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/2b4c469bdf3e0dfff63f251c894297cfcc534d1be3e8ae5fc3b3126c9444c444.png)
that currently make the car up.

Very productive session tbh!
